question: Which hospital is nearest when considering the northeast direction of Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History Sea Center, Santa Barbara, CA?
sql:
WITH origin AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.685686 34.410426)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois,origin
WHERE pois.amenity = 'hospital'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> origin.geometry ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History Sea Center, Santa Barbara, CA

poi.poi_name: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History Sea Center
